items.text: Please don't buy this. This thing is completely non-interactive, You listen to a boring guy complain about his banal worries for 20 minutes and that's it. The characters mentioned in the description are too shallow to make this kind of thing even remotely interesting.
items.text_zh: 请不要买这个。这东西完全是非交互式的，你听一个无聊的家伙抱怨他平庸的烦恼二十分钟，就这样。描述中提到的角色太肤浅了，根本无法让这种东西哪怕有一点点有趣。

observations.description: 描述中提到的角色过于肤浅，无法让内容有趣
